summary: Comprehensive architectural and UX implementation plan for PaisaTrack, a native Android personal finance and expense tracker built with Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, Material 3, MVVM, and local Room persistence. Covers user-confirmed decisions (overall + category monthly budgets, category donut + monthly trend charts, Indian Rupee number formatting, CSV export, and sample data loader), emerald-accented light/dark visual design, interactive flows, and data architecture.
